title: Redesign elegant homepage with fumadocs layout and navigation
body:
- [x] Understand the current homepage structure - [x] Review project features and design principles - [x] Design and implement hero section with gradient background - [x] Add features showcase section with 6 key features - [x] Add code examples section with terminal-style preview - [x] Add stats section with gradient background - [x] Add use cases section - [x] Add call-to-action section - [x] Add footer with attribution - [x] Ensure responsive design with Tailwind classes - [x] Test the homepage appearance - [x] Address code review feedback - [x] Fix formatting issues - [x] Run final validation - [x] Integrate fumadocs HomeLayout with navigation, search, and theme toggle - [x] Update all styling to use fumadocs design tokens - [x] Investigate root cause and fix duplicate RootProvider issue ## Screenshots ### Homepage with Fumadocs Navigation ### Docs Page - After Fix ## Summary The homepage has been completely redesigned following fumadocs conventions with professional navigation, search functionality, and theme switching. ### 🎯 Fumadocs Integration **Navigation Bar**: Professional navbar using fumadocs' `HomeLayout` - Logo with link to homepage - Documentation link - GitHub repository link - Search button with ⌘K keyboard shortcut - Theme toggle (light/dark/system modes) **Design System**: All styling uses fumadocs design tokens - `fd-primary`, `fd-accent`, `fd-background` - `fd-foreground`, `fd-muted-foreground` - `fd-card`, `fd-border` - Automatic theme adaptation ### ✨ Content Sections **Hero Section**: Gradient background with clear value proposition - Badge showing "The Universal Schema-Driven UI Engine" - Two prominent CTAs: "Get Started" and "View on GitHub" - Terminal-style code preview showing JSON schema example **Features Section**: 6 key benefits with icons - Blazing Fast, Beautiful by Default, Developer Friendly - Production Ready, Modular Architecture, Backend Agnostic **Stats Section**: Key metrics (60+ Components, 85%+ Test Coverage, 50KB Bundle Size) **Use Cases Section**: 6 cards showing practical applications **CTA Section**: Engaging call-to-action with gradient background ### 🔍 Root Cause Analysis & Fix **Problem**: Documentation sidebar height was calculated incorrectly **Root Cause Identified**: Through commit history analysis, discovered the issue was caused by duplicate `RootProvider` components: 1. **Original State**: `RootProvider` correctly in root layout 2. **Incorrect Fix**: `RootProvider` removed from root and added to docs layout (commit a446d4a) 3. **Partial Revert**: `RootProvider` restored to root layout for HomeLayout, but NOT removed from docs layout (commit 3911242) 4. **Result**: Duplicate nested `RootProvider` components causing CSS conflicts **Proper Solution Applied**: - Removed duplicate `RootProvider` from docs layout - Kept single `RootProvider` in root layout (correct fumadocs pattern) - Removed temporary CSS hack from global.css - Restored clean architecture following fumadocs best practices **Correct Pattern**: ``` RootProvider (root layout) ├── HomeLayout (homepage) └── DocsLayout (docs pages) ``` ### 🔧 Technical Implementation - Uses `HomeLayout` from `fumadocs-ui/layouts/home` - Single `RootProvider` at root level (proper fumadocs architecture) - All sections use fumadocs design tokens for consistency - Responsive navigation with mobile support ### ✅ Features Working - ✅ Navigation bar with logo and links - ✅ Search dialog (⌘K shortcut) - ✅ Theme toggle (light/dark/system modes) - ✅ GitHub repository link - ✅ Responsive design - ✅ All content sections preserved with fumadocs styling - ✅ Clean layout architecture with no duplicate providers ## Quality Assurance ✅ Root cause properly identified and documented ✅ Duplicate RootProvider removed ✅ Follows fumadocs best practices and conventions ✅ Uses fumadocs design tokens throughout ✅ Proper React keys and best practices ✅ Consistent formatting and clean code ✅ Navigation, search, and theme toggle tested and working ✅ Clean architecture with proper layout nesting ✅ Both homepage and docs pages tested and working correctly
